fixed.explanation: _format_multi sparsifies using the formatted strings, so distinct float values that print identically are treated as the same group and blanked. I added an optional `keys` argument to sparsify_labels. It compares those keys, and _format_multi passes the level codes, so repeats are detected by identity instead of by text.
